usage: The word 恤衫 (seot1 saam1) refers to a shirt, commonly worn as a top garment.
It is a countable noun, so you can say 'one shirt' or 'two shirts', e.g., 一件恤衫 (jat1 gin6 seot1 saam1).
You can describe the shirt by adding adjectives before it, like 'red shirt' (紅色恤衫).
In shopping contexts, 恤衫 is a common item you would ask for or describe when looking for clothes.
You can also use 恤衫 in the plural without changing the form, but usually quantify it with 件 (gin6).
